paper_title: Analysis of atomic-clock data to constrain variations of fundamental constants
coupling_convention: dimensionless d_gamma (d_e) in Damour-Donoghue convention, coupling normalized to gravitational strength kappa=1/(sqrt(2) M_P)
notes: NPL atomic-clock comparison (Yb+/Sr, Sr/Cs, 133Cs fountain) constraining oscillations of alpha and mu. Main new exclusion is on the linear scalar-photon coupling d^(1)_gamma from Yb+/Sr data over 1e-20 eV <~ m_phi <~ 1e-17 eV (Fig. 6), assuming ULDM saturating rho_DM ~ 0.3 GeV/cm^3. No table given; data points reconstructed from the text formula d^(1) = zeta^(1)_f * A_alpha(f) with zeta^(1)_f ~ 2.0e16 f/Hz, the global amplitude bound A_alpha ~ 5.6e-18, and the stated stochastic degradation factor ~3, so d^(1)_gamma ~ 0.34*(f/Hz); masses via m = 4.136e-15 * f. Values are approximate reconstructions of the flat-noise exclusion line, not digitized from the figure. Paper also constrains d_me - d_g, quadratic couplings, Higgs coupling A, and axion-gluon 1/f_a (secondary results not extracted).
